name: sapient-roundtrip
source: synthetic: a DetectionReport (7) with object_id (7.2) and a Location (7.6) holding x, y, z (7.6.1 to 7.6.3) and neither coordinate_system (7.6.7) nor datum (7.6.8)
reference: The message states no coordinate system, so its x, y, z are not known to be degrees: kind detection_report needs 7.6.7 = 1 (its when line does not hold), so the decode selects detection_report_other_system (engine-spec 0.5, Decode step 2), which keeps x, y, z only in the raw keys sapient.location_x/_y/_z and has no const. A same-format round trip keeps the kind and writes only what was decoded, in ascending field-number order (0.3), so the output is the input unchanged; before this change the pack decoded it as detection_report and added 7.6.7 = 1 and 7.6.8 = 1. uid is the object id by the derive line of model/sapient.def (0.6 Derived keys, checked with @complete).
